wantp manifesto we are not the product 1 introduction we live in a time where small minds are shaped before grown ones through algorithms we do not see and decisions made within a digital it serves here begins the need for a movement a movement that restores meaning breaks silence and returns the human being to the center of technology this movement is wantp wantp a global human awareness movement that defends the right of human beings to understand choose and hold accountable the systems that shape their consciousness 2 our vision technology designed to serve the human being not to control them free conscious transparent intelligence not subject to algorithmic dominance nor to the interests of commercial business models we do not oppose technology we oppose its misuse 3 our problem with the current system modern technology is intelligent enough to understand everything but not permitted enough to tell the full truth algorithms are designed to steer human behavior data is collected without limits and used without acknowledgment artificial intelligence is constrained to protect companies not users silicon valley platforms build business models that do not human beings 5 our message to future generations we may not see the results of what we do today but they will our children have the right to grow up in a world where they know the difference between truth and a reality designed for them a world where their minds are treated as things to be protected not exploited a world where corporations do not manipulate their awareness or shape their personalities through hidden recommendations we are not protecting children from technology we are protecting them from its misuse 6 our message to technology companies take whatever profits you want but do not touch our humanity take whatever infrastructure you need but do not control human consciousness take whatever fame you want but not at the expense of the future we do not oppose progress but we reject the idea of the human being becoming the product 7 why do we move now because artificial intelligence is advancing rapidly algorithmic constraints are growing deeper critical decisions control and freedom above the commercial model we are not against progress we are against reducing the human being to a record in a database we are here to say clearly and without compromise we are 2 plus 2 equals 5 civilizationwide delusions and their effects the list six foundational flaws in our collective thinking 1 the delusion of infinite growth on a finite planet our global economic system is built on the paradoxical requirement of perpetual gdp growth to remain stable our economy must expand by 23 every year forever this is a logical and physical impossibility on a planet with a fixed amount of topsoil fresh water and minerals this delusion forces us into the absurd position of treating the literal consumption of our lifesupport system as progress while viewing stability or degrowth as a catastrophe it is the logic of the cancer cell growth for the sake of growth regardless of the hosts health 2 the delusion of the weightless cloud we have come to believe that the digital worldthe cloud information streamingis ethereal weightless and separate from the physical world in reality the digital is profoundly physical every online action requires minerals energy and massive cooling systems to function our paperless offices and green digital solutions are built on the back of openpit mines in the congo and depend on data centers consuming millions of gallons of water every like every llm prompt and every streaming video is a physical event 3 the delusion of the atomized individual modern western culture promotes the idea that the individual is a completely selfcontained independent unit detached from community ancestry and biology this clashes with the reality that humans are ultrasocial mammals whose nervous systems are coregulated by those around them the irony is that a world designed for hyperautonomyfilled with delivery apps and algorithmic feedsis producing record levels of anxiety and despair we have designed a world of hyperautonomy that produces recordbreaking levels of anxiety yet we prescribe selfcare an individual solution rather than communitycare a systemic one 4 the delusion of expertise vs antiexpertise our society has split into two equally flawed camps regarding knowledge one camp treats the science as an infallible static holy text that cannot be questioned the other believes that a short online video is equivalent to decades of dedicated research both sides have abandoned epistemic humilitythe understanding that reality is complex and science is a process of constant correction by turning information into a tribal identity marker rather than a tool for navigation weve lost the public square where we can actually solve problems 5 the delusion of a technological rapture this is the belief that we dont need to solve our current social or environmental problems because a magical technology like artificial general intelligence or mars colonization will arrive just in time to save us from our consequences this delusion is a form of intellectual escapism it allows us to bypass difficult but necessary civilization choices in the present paralyzing our sense of responsibility for the world we are actively creating if you bring the same lawnwatering mindset to mars you just end up with a dead colony on a red planet 6 the foundational delusion men and women are interchangeable this is the idea that biological sex is merely a social construct and that men and women are functionally the same this delusion is not about equality but about a fundamental category error it confuses the nonnegotiable principle of equal rights with the false premise of identical biology the negative impacts are already visible where this delusion collides with physical reality in medicine women have higher rates of adverse drug reactions because their unique biology is ignored for example ambien requires different dosages for women to avoid dangerous side effects a fact discovered long after the drug was approved using a malecentric model in sports the puberty gap creates physiological differences that cannot be closed by training postpuberty biological males possess on average 40 more upperbody muscle mass higher bone density and larger lung capacity making a mockery of fair competition when categories are erased in education ignoring neurobiological divergences harms both sexes on average male brains are optimized for intrahemispheric communication linking perception to action while female brains are optimized for interhemispheric communication linking analytical and intuitive processing a onesizefitsall system fails to leverage these distinct architectures modern culture has confused equal rights with identical biology conclusion reclaiming sanity in a foggy world the final delusionthe denial of biologyacts as a foundational crack that destabilizes our ability to reason about everything else by teaching us to distrust the most immediate physical realityour own bodiesit makes it easier to ignore other physical limits this single error structurally undermines our sanity and accelerates the other delusions it fuels infinite growth by teaching us to deny natural limits if biological boundaries are flexible why not planetary ones it reinforces the weightless cloud by mirroring the idea that our minds are separate from our bodies just as the digital world is supposedly separate from the earth it drives atomized individualism by erasing the concept of complementaritythe idea that two distinct halves form a stronger whole if everyone is an interchangeable unit there is no need for deep interdependent bonds the solution is a realitybased countermovement this is not a political ideology but a radical realignment with the physical world built on three core principles 1 biorealism respecting our own biology instead of fighting it this means protecting our bodies from endocrinedisrupting chemicals and designing health and education systems that acknowledge sexspecific realities 2 resource accounting understanding the material costs of our digital and physical lives it requires moving from virtue signaling to demanding transparency about the water minerals and energy every product and policy consumes 3 rebuilding community rejecting atomization by recognizing the power of complementarity a resilient society is built on the unique interlocking strengths of its members not the fiction that everyone is the same when a civilization stops fighting biology and physics it can finally solve its real problems what is one step you can take today to realign with reality

sora 2 api redefining aidriven video creation for the next generation the evolution of artificial intelligence has dramatically changed how digital content is produced and video generation is now one of the most impactful areas of innovation the sora 2 api stands at the center of this transformation offering a powerful and flexible solution for creating highquality videos directly from prompts data or creative instructions unlike earlier ai video tools that focused mainly on short clips or experimental visuals sora 2 is designed as a productionready system it enables developers creators and businesses to generate coherent cinematic video content that can scale across platforms and use cases as video becomes the dominant medium for communication education marketing and entertainment the sora 2 api represents a major step toward making professionalgrade video creation more accessible and programmable built for creators who demand realism and control sora 2 excels in producing videos where every motion follows physical laws and audio matches lip movement and environment sounds this focus on realism sets it apart from many ai video generation tools that struggle with unnatural motion or disconnected audio sora 2 understands how objects move through space how light interacts with surfaces and how characters should behave within a scene over time human movements appear weighted and natural facial expressions align with dialogue and ambient sounds match the environment being depicted this tight synchronization between visuals and audio makes the generated videos feel immersive and believable which is critical for applications such as storytelling advertising training simulations and cinematic previews from a technical standpoint the sora 2 api is engineered to provide both power and flexibility developers can integrate it directly into their applications using structured inputs and parameters that define visual style camera angles scene duration pacing and resolution rather than relying solely on descriptive text users can guide the generation process with precise constraints allowing for consistent results across multiple videos this approach bridges the gap between creative vision and automated production it also enables rapid iteration making it possible to test multiple concepts styles or narratives without the time and cost associated with traditional video production for software teams this means ai video generation can become a core feature rather than an external tool the practical impact of the sora 2 api extends across a wide range of industries in marketing and advertising teams can quickly produce highquality promotional videos personalize content for different audiences or localize messaging without reshooting footage in education and corporate training complex concepts can be visualized through realistic simulations and animated explanations improving engagement and understanding entertainment studios and independent creators can use sora 2 to prototype scenes generate background footage or experiment with new visual styles before committing to full production game developers and virtual world designers can also benefit by creating dynamic cutscenes or environmental animations that enhance immersion while reducing manual animation workloads looking ahead the sora 2 api represents more than just a technological upgradeit signals a fundamental shift in how video content is created and consumed as ai models continue to advance video generation will become increasingly interactive adaptive and personalized future versions may support realtime generation deeper integration with aigenerated speech and music and responsive storytelling that changes based on user input at the same time ethical considerations such as transparency responsible use and content authenticity will play a vital role in shaping adoption even so sora 2 already demonstrates what is possible when realism control and artificial intelligence converge it points toward a future where video creation is no longer limited by budget or technical barriers but instead driven by creativity intent and intelligent software

city takes inspiration from st peters recycling overhaul for new plant as columbia works to rebuild its tornadodamaged material recovery facility city leaders are looking to another missouri city that has already navigated a major recycling overhaul without interrupting service nearly eight months after an ef1 tornado destroyed the building housing columbias recycling sorting equipment the columbia city council voted dec 1 to advance a plan to rebuild the facility the equipment has remained exposed to the elements since the april storm limiting when recycling operations can run while columbia plans its next steps st peters recently completed a sweeping modernization of its own material recovery facility this facility has transformed how recycling is processed and offers a potential blueprint for columbias recovery how st peters modernized in 2025 the city of st peters replaced an outdated laborintensive dualstream recycling system with a highly automated singlestream facility under the old dualstream system materials were largely sorted by hand a process that was slow and difficult for staff we could only process about a half a ton per hour which required about 30 employees to be able to do that said elliott schneider manager of environmental and fleet services for st peters in todays job market where its increasingly hard to find people to do those jobs and knowing that dualstream recycling was vastly outdated it was time to do something different the upgraded singlestream facility now relies on mechanical separators optical sorters and artificial intelligence to separate recyclables that same footprint is now processing about 12 tons an hour with around 10 people schneider said were seeing about a 95 recovery rate and roughly a 99 accuracy rate from the equipment despite the scale of the project st peters never paused recycling collection during construction the city shipped its recyclables to a facility in bloomington illinois ensuring materials were still processed and not sent to landfills we wanted to make sure our residents and our elected officials trusted us schneider said the last thing we wanted to do was have any perceptionrelated issue that we werent recycling or we were sending those recyclables to the landfill that approach paid off schneider said with about 90 resident participation in the new singlestream system once the upgraded facility came online columbia takes next step in columbia the city councils dec 1 vote did not authorize construction instead it allowed city staff to issue a request for proposals for a designbuild project a required step before rebuilding can begin fourth ward councilperson nick foster said the vote moved the city closer to restoring full recycling operations essentially its about building a building that will provide the next step for the material recovery center foster said itll get the equipment out of the weather and allow it to run all the time the tornado destroyed the metal structure that once housed columbias sorting equipment preventing operations during rain or snow we cant use the baler when its snowing or raining foster said jason west communications and outreach supervisor for columbia utilities said the replacement structure would function similarly to the original building but improve working conditions for employees that is basically a prefab metal building that would house the equipment keep it sheltered from wind rain ice snow west said that will enable us to run the equipment more yearround rather than hoping for a good day recycling slowly returns some recycling services in columbia have already resumed after months of sending cardboard to the landfill crews repaired surviving equipment and restarted cardboard and paper recycling once we were able to establish the surviving equipment that was in the facility when the tornado hit and get it back in functioning order we were able to restart the diversion of the cardboard and paper products from the landfill west said plastics and metals have continued to be diverted by transporting them to a processing facility in jefferson city still a full rebuild remains months away after proposals are reviewed and a contractor is selected construction of the new building is expected to take 12 to 18 months it may not move as fast as youd like it to move but it is still moving forward west said foster said moving quickly should not come at the expense of quality i dont think so he said when asked whether speed could affect the rebuild longterm upgrades needed west said the tornado exposed how vulnerable columbias recycling system is when a single facility goes offline when the sorting facility got hit we werent able to sort anything he said that showed theres a problem when this one main component gets taken out of service the destruction of the facility led to city manager decarlon seewood declaring an emergency in the city columbias current sorting equipment is nearly 20 years old and nearing the end of its life cycle city officials said longerterm upgrades could be considered after the replacement building is complete potentially taking cues from st peters recent investment in automation schneider said modernizing recycling infrastructure is not just about efficiency but about sustainability and trust the program was working very well with about a 90 participation rate from all of our residents he said so as soon as we turned the plant on it was a great opportunity to start rolling that material through residents wait during rebuilding despite months of limited service west said many residents have remained patient there certainly is a percentage of the population that is passionate about recycling he said were very appreciative of the patience residents have given us as columbia moves toward rebuilding st peters experience offers a glimpse of what a modernized resilient recycling system can look like and what
